San Leonardo e stazione — Parma, Italy

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

The station and the quarter behind it, and the one part of Parma with a designated zona rossa. ParmaToday's reportage from inside it describes massed checks, pushers running, and residents who grip their bag in the underpass; shopkeepers and residents of San Leonardo went public saying they feel abandoned, with reports of crack and heroin use in front of homes. The Comune has assigned community officers to the quarter as part of a plan for thirty more local police. Many of Parma's cheaper rooms are here — the rating is the station end at night.
